title: Race results: original Stunt Score and Profile Points
summary: Race Results now show the original Stunt Score and Profile Points columns. Profile Points follow the exact-build single-race award rule and accumulate in a local player profile.
details: Exact-build evidence: the race-over award routine 001f1e30 gives a human racer 10, 5 and 1 Profile Points for 1st, 2nd and 3rd in a single race, adds the race stunt score / 1000, and gives nothing in 5th or without a profile; championship rounds instead use the course TOY [ChampionshipInfo] tables (Am/Pro x Normal/Hard, places 1-5) read by 0020a8d0.
The race stunt score counts the player's stunt points between GO and the finish.

One implicit local profile (browser localStorage / desktop settings, key fury-profile) is credited once when the results open: points, races, wins, best race stunt score; the summary line shows "+N Profile Points (T total)".

Verification: atv-core profile/race unit tests; new browser test test_engine_race_profile_points.mjs drives the player with the race path driver through a one-lap SX01 race (player won, +10, profile 100 -> 110, credited once); test_engine_race and test_engine_race_finish_gate pass.
limitation: Championship mode itself is not implemented yet.
caption: Race Results on SX01 with the new Stunt Score and Profile Points columns (host Chromium, autopilot run).
